content:
sophia_sales: Heads-up: Trident follow-up — they want token billing to match exactly and no user-visible output diffs for our POC next Tue. main asks: drop-in /v1/generate parity, SAML SSO, and EU data residency.

tom_engse: can we get a minimal set of sample requests/responses from them? need to enumerate edge cases (lists, multi-line, and stop tokens).

sophia_sales: uploaded samples to drive: https://redwood.atl/drive/trident/poc-samples.json

lina_sre: capacity note: target 800 rps steady, 1.5k peak. Dedicated reservation recommended for consistent 95th-ms. VPC onboarding ~72h.

omar_security: security checklist: SAML, KMS-integration, EU-only logs retention, and export-control flags. can we support KMS key import for their HSM?

peggy_finance: pricing question: they want delta for shared hosted vs Dedicated (incl. SLA). I'll need a rough per-hour GPU + network calc.

tom_engse: mapping idea: Trident.prompt -> input; Trident.max_tokens -> token_limit; stop array -> stop_sequences. but watch for their implicit stop precedence vs our post-truncate behavior.

sophia_sales: can we do a server-side compat shim to emulate Trident stop semantics? we'd prefer not to change core model behavior.

tom_engse: yes — X-Compat: trident header to enable server-side transforms (truncate on first stop token, normalize whitespace). will also log the transform rules to help triage.

lina_sre: ops: deploy shim to staging, run token-billing harness comparing token counts and costs across 100 sample prompts.

omar_security: on EU residency: Private (VPC) supports EU-only. if they need <48h, hosted eu region with contractual data residency notes is fallback but audit docs slower. note this in questionnaire.

peggy_finance: will produce hosted vs dedicated delta by EOD. quick ask: any legal minimum term for Dedicated? sales prefers 1-week reserved for POC.

tom_engse: short-term reserved pool for 1 week is possible; quote will reflect one-week commit + provisioning fee.

sophia_sales: action items:
- tom_engse: field-mapping doc + example shim header + sample curl (due tomorrow 9am PT)
- peggy_finance: pricing delta hosted vs dedicated + one-week reserved quote (due EOD)
- omar_security: answer SAML/KMS/export-control items in questionnaire (due 48h)
- lina_sre: confirm VPC onboarding lead time and IP allowlist (due tomorrow 10am PT)

deploybot: compat-shim branch deployed to staging, smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:.
